discoverySummary.deloitteOutcome: Deloitte: no verified eligible new opening today. Deloitte India/USI/South Asia were searched first; no new exact requisition met the fresher eligibility, completeness and duplicate safeguards.
heldReview: Avaloq Graduate Trainee-PMO - final re-open returned an access error after earlier exact-page evidence; staged as UNCONFIRMED.
HCLTech Fresher AIML Developer 162110 - exact official content is visible, but no applicant-facing Apply control was exposed; staged as UNCONFIRMED.
EY Analyst - TAX - GCR - source content conflicts between fresher qualification text and a 1–3 year narrative requirement; held.
Certa and AiStudio internship pages exposed JavaScript-only shells; held rather than marked expired.
Several priority-employer portals returned blocked, generic or experience-only listings; those were not promoted to the batch.
expiredSignals: Two exact official candidates screened during discovery showed authoritative closure or passed eligibility/deadline evidence and were excluded.
discoverySummary.note: Fresh 22 Oct discovery. Flexible fresher categories applied. Historical jobs, archived review batches, queued requests and Telegram receipts were checked before selection. One employer per combined Priority and Backup set. Avaloq and HCLTech remain held outside the persisted batch because the Android workflow only notifies for all-Live source-complete candidates.
